force.title: The Compliance Tax
force.signature: A patchwork of AI, privacy, climate, and cyber rules turns compliance into a rising cost — it favors scale, feeds the consultants, and prices out the small operator.

A \u00b7 Finance under the rules: Capital, KYC, and consumer rules make compliance a moat for big banks.
State-by-state rules and new risks make insurance a compliance-heavy, data-heavy game.
B \u00b7 Healthcare's paperwork: Regulation and reimbursement rules make admin a huge, growing cost center.
Privacy and cyber rules raise the cost of holding data — and create a security market.
C \u00b7 The compliance-industrial compl: Lawyers, auditors, and accountants sell the compliance the rules require.
Climate and environmental mandates create work and cost in equal measure.
D \u00b7 The tensions: Compliance cost is fixed, so it hits small firms hardest and pushes consolidation.
New AI-governance rules land first on data, credit, and software.
E \u00b7 The big picture: Capstone: rules multiply into a tax that favors scale and feeds advisors; small operators pay the most.
